title: System Control Board 3b-3: no contact with Overpass while it's held; Pulse sorts 0172's Urgent and Special
why: Jason's answer on Overpass (2026-11-18, relayed by the session manager after #139): 'it goes in the queue as an issue a person resolves … stop the daily status probe of the held Overpass servers; no contact at all while they're held. The alarm clears only when a person resolves it (Reactivate on OpenStreetMap's card after OSM releases us), never by itself.' (1) ServiceHealth::noProbe: an OpenStreetMap server that refused us (a ban, a key, a quota) gets no probe, not even /api/status, from the crawler (dueProbes) or the site (allowed), none is scheduled for a new one, and Check it now sends nothing; a timeout still backs off and other services keep their light probes. (2) The words: the trip says we don't contact them while held and it never clears by itself; the case and the server's line no longer promise 'or its probe answers'; our statement to the OpenStreetMap community now says we don't contact a server at all while it blocks us (research/osm-overpass §2 the same); the FAQ's outside-services and board entries. (3) Pulse's sort knows 0172's six levels (urgent between critical and alert, special last), asked by the Communications session. Decision 0171 §8 has the note. Tests: r3b.php 21 (4 new), r3a 24, r2d 9, r2b 14, w2-verify 5, layout 8. Built on Sync 20:17 UTC (3b-2, #139, live).

items: No new fatal errors in the logs
